text:
maria: Quick sync — we need prioritization input for the Optimize toolkit launch wedges. Three principal asks from pilots: adaptive per-route batching suggestions, a KV-prefix caching heuristic that respects tenant isolation, and a quantization recommender for bf16/int8 tradeoffs. Goal: Beta in Q3. Who owns acceptance criteria + what can we defer?

ajay: +1. can we split into "must-have" vs "nice-to-have"? i'd push quant recommender to nice-to-have if caching+batching deliver >25% token cost reduction.

kelly: Pilot customers care most about predictable p95 latency and cost delta. acceptance should include both econ and latency SLOs. sample criteria suggestion below.

kelly: ```
MUST: end-to-end e2e for batching+cache on two pilot routes, p95 latency <= 350ms, token cost reduction >= 20% vs baseline, no user-visible errors introduced.
NICE: quant recommender prototype that suggests quant level with simulated accuracy delta <= 1.5% on eval set.
ROLLOUT: canary traffic to 5% then 25% then 100% with automatic rollback on SLI breaches.
```

sam: real ask from cust A — they absolutely want eval-triggered alerting: when generation quality drops on a prompt set, we should trigger an ops alert and surface recommended rollback or model variant. can we scope a lightweight webhook that ops can consume?

maria: yes agree on eval-alerts MVP: webhook + summary + top-3 offending prompts. keep it behind a feature flag.

tony: ops concerns: caching heuristics must preserve PII boundaries — any prefix-based cache must be able to respect tenant scopes and opt-out. also eviction TTLs need product-visible configs.

ajay: implementation note: adaptive batching requires sequence-length histograms per route. we should collect lightweight histograms (bucketed) and run offline bucket optimizer. that keeps runtime simple.

kelly: for quant recommender, instead of running full per-cust evals at launch, deliver a simulator that uses a small eval-set representative of customer traffic. that reduces onboarding friction.

sam: pilot rollout plan proposal: Cust A gets batching+cache alpha in their staging namespace for 2 weeks -> measure econ+latency -> enable eval-alerts -> quant recommender opt-in.

maria: dependencies: infra needs KV-prefixed multi-tenant cache with tenant isolation (eng-infra), telemetry team needs new histogram metrics (eng-sre), eval infra needs a lightweight scoring pipeline (eng-ml). can owners chime?

ops-bot: @eng-infra assigned: caching-multi-tenant. ticket created: INF-6123.

tony: noted. we'd also want kill-switch per-tenant and per-route. add to rollouts doc.

ajay: rough timeline: Q2 sprint 3 — infra proto + hist metrics; Q2 sprint 4 — batch policy + caching alpha; Q3 sprint 1 — pilot beta, eval-alert webhook; Q3 sprint 2 — wider rollout.

kelly: acceptance tests to add to repo: integration test that validates tenant isolation when cache key overlap occurs, perf test for p95 latency under typical load, and a small accuracy regression test for quant suggestions.

maria: next steps: 1) agree must/nice lists (comment here by EOD) 2) owners to file tickets for infra/telemetry/eval 3) draft pilot runbook + rollback playbook. i'll consolidate and run a 30-min sync tomorrow 10am. :calendar: :thumbsup:

ajay: I'll file batching ticket and add hist metric RFC.

kelly: i'll draft acceptance PR and pilot runbook.

sam: i'll reach out to cust A and schedule staging window.

tony: i'll make kill-switch and TTL config changes a priority.

maria: thanks all — i'll post the consolidated scope doc after the sync.
